A BlitzLLVM extension: tells whether the window is shown in HDR right now, which is when [AutoHDR](AutoHDR) is on and the swapchain that it needs was made. It changes at the [Flip](Flip) after AutoHDR or the display changed.
@returns 1 if the window is shown in HDR, else 0.
